question: In the CO2-WAG stacking-learning study, which of the three base proxy models had the lowest MSE over the whole data bank, and how many hidden layers and neurons does it have?
rendered:
The first base model (Tansig) had the lowest MSE over the whole data bank. 

According to the text on page 13, the first base model uses the Tansig transfer function. It has two hidden layers, with 24 neurons in the first layer and 14 neurons in the second layer.
